candidate_evidence.quote: Patients who are eligible for the study will be administered a regular 200 mg dose of FDA approved drug amantadine.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: patients diagnosed with glioblastoma (newly or recurrent) who are following the standard of care

role_evidence.quote: Amantadine Hydrochloride: Patients who are eligible for the study will be administered a regular 200 mg dose of FDA approved drug amantadine.
the study aims to determine the usefulness of amantadine as a diagnostic biomarker for GBM.

agents.drug_class_hint: antiviral/antiparkinsonian drug used as an SSAT1 substrate probe

coder_notes: Amantadine is given as a diagnostic probe (acetyl-amantadine in blood/urine), registered as Diagnostic Test, no antitumour hypothesis. Acetyl-amantadine/SSAT1 activity is a drug-metabolite readout in blood/urine, not coded as a tumour molecular biomarker. Temozolomide/lomustine are standard care and not registered interventions.
